A11y.title: Accessibility
A11y.lead: Kingdom Hearts Univers should stay usable by everyone, whatever the device, eyesight or way of browsing. This page explains what is in place and lets you adjust the display.
A11y.settingsHelp: These settings are stored on this device, in this browser. They are never sent anywhere. “System” follows your operating system preference.
A11y.saved: Settings apply straight away and are kept for your next visits.

contrast.title: Contrast
contrast.help: Increases contrast: plain backgrounds, sharp borders, secondary text as legible as body text, underlined links.

motion.title: Motion
motion.help: Removes transitions, hover movement and smooth scrolling.

text.title: Text size
text.help: Enlarges all content, layout included. Your browser zoom (Ctrl and +) still works on top of it.

keyboard.title: Everything by keyboard
keyboard.text: Skip link, logical tab order, submenus and search (Ctrl + K) usable without a mouse, visible focus outline everywhere.

contrast.title: Checked contrast
contrast.text: All four themes (Dawn, Day, Dusk, Night) meet the 4.5:1 AA ratio, verified automatically on the key pages.

structure.title: Explicit structure
structure.text: Landmarks, ranked headings, announced lists and up-to-date ARIA states: the content reads just as well with a screen reader.

images.title: Described images
images.text: Every illustration carries alternative text or is marked decorative, with its source credited on the entry.

language.title: Declared language
language.text: Each page declares its language to the browser, and original titles are tagged in their own language for correct pronunciation.

A11y.feedbackText: An obstacle you run into is a defect to fix. Report it on the project's GitHub repository, describing the page and how you browse: it will be handled as a priority.

About.title: About
About.lead: A hand-written fan site, with no ads and no trackers, gathering in one place what the Kingdom Hearts saga has scattered over twenty years and some fifteen games.
About.projectText:
Kingdom Hearts Univers started from a simple observation: most documentation on the saga is in English, and what exists in French is often partial or scattered. This site brings together the games, characters, worlds, Keyblades, the story of each entry and the timelines, in a form meant to be read from beginning to end.

Everything is written and checked by hand, game by game, cross-referencing the sources listed below. The site is a personal, volunteer, non-profit project: no advertising, no trackers, nothing for sale.

It is also built to be usable by everyone: full keyboard navigation, checked contrast, display settings, and content that shows up even without JavaScript.

sources.title: Sources and thanks
sources.lead: Facts (names, stats, dates, appearances) are checked against the community wikis, then rewritten here in our own words. The site's texts are not translations of those sources. Thanks to the volunteers who keep them up to date.
sources.khwiki: English reference: weapon stats, Japanese names, appearances by game.
sources.frwiki: Official French names of Keyblades, enemies and worlds.
sources.khdestiny: The long-standing French fan site, an inspiration for the layout.

privacy.title: Personal data
privacy.text: The site sets no cookies, uses no analytics and collects no personal data. The only settings kept (theme, contrast, motion, text size) stay in your browser, on your device, and are never transmitted.
